notes:
{傷|きず} refers to wounds, scratches, or flaws - physical damage or imperfections.

USAGE:
1. Physical injury: {傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧ (to get injured)
2. Surface damage: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{傷|きず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (car gets scratched)
3. Abstract flaw: ⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{傷|きず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (reputation is damaged)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {傷|きず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to get scratched/damaged
- {傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧: to sustain an injury
- {傷|きず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}る→直る：00735_naoru⟧: wound heals
- {傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手当|てあ}てする→手当：04881_teate⟧: to treat a wound

- ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧: wound opening
- ⟦{無傷|むきず}→無傷：13458_mukizu⟧: uninjured, unscathed
